<details>
The PKGBUILD is a standard VCS (-git) package for `yay-ai-review-git`. It clones the package's own upstream GitHub repository (`git+https://github.com/schuay/yay-ai-review.git`) and uses `sha256sums=('SKIP')`, which is normal and expected for VCS sources. The `pkgver()` function derives the version from git commits, and `package()` installs files into `$pkgdir` using standard `install` commands. There are no network requests to unrelated hosts, no obfuscated code, no `eval`/`base64`/decoded blobs, and no file operations outside the package directory. Optional dependencies reference AI backends consistent with the package's stated purpose as an AI review hook for yay. No supply-chain attack indicators are present.
</details>
